title: VersionGraphNodeAdded.v1
description: Validated and sequenced node added to a template version DAG. Replicated to every cell (local DAG replica in ms-engagement-index) and consumed by ms-change-summary to pre-generate the parent->child summary. Template metadata only.
$comment: Source: DISENO 4.3 catalog EV-03; RF-002, RF-003, RF-018, RF-091; US-01.1.1, US-07.1.2. Producer: ms-template-catalog. Consumers: ms-engagement-index, ms-change-summary. Channel: global EventBridge bus -> rule -> SQS of ms-change-summary; global bus -> cell EventBridge buses (whitelist) -> one rule per consumer -> SQS. Ordering/partition key: templateId + templateSeq. Idempotency key: eventId; (templateId, templateSeq). Guarantee: at-least-once; order rebuilt by templateSeq. Versioning: additive within v1 (DISENO 4.2). dataClass: TEMPLATE_PUBLIC (DISENO 4.3). Crosses regions (whitelisted in the EventBridge rules); must not contain engagementId, firmId, userId or free text (contract test, DISENO 4.1).
x-channel: global EventBridge bus -> rule -> SQS of ms-change-summary; global bus -> cell EventBridge buses (whitelist) -> one rule per consumer -> SQS

version.description: Version label of the new node.

parents.description: Parent version labels (same meaning as TemplateGraphNode.parents).

templateSeq.description: templateSeq assigned by ms-template-catalog, monotonic per template (ADR-018, DEC-03). Consumers apply strictly in order (appliedSeq = templateSeq - 1). minimum 1 because template.last_seq starts at 0 (DISENO S1 V1__registry_baseline.sql).
